newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian dollar falls, bonds firm on data.
newsitem.headline: Australian dollar falls, bonds firm on data.

text.p: The Australian dollar fell and bonds rose after the second quarter average weekly ordinary time earnings (AWOTE) came in lower than expectations.
Quarterly AWOTE rose 0.5 percent for an annual rate of 3.7 percent compared with median expectations for a 0.8 percent and 4.1 percent repectively.

The dollar was US$0.7331/36 compared with US$0.7342/47 just before the data, while the September 10-year bond futures contract touched a high of 93.630 against a pre-data 93.580. Bill futures also rose, moving to 94.98 from 94.90.
